whoItsFor: Knowledge workers and developers who want to create and edit real .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, and PDF files locally with an AI assistant, using their own API key. Coding-agent users (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) can also drive it through the genoffice CLI and skill.
useCases: Edit Word documents with AI suggestions shown as tracked changes that can be rolled back
Build Excel workbooks with live formulas, summary sheets, and charts from a single prompt
Generate and edit PowerPoint decks from a one-line prompt, or convert PDFs to Word on-device

requirements.os: macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (x64 and Arm), Linux (deb, rpm, AppImage)
